qualification.details: Audiologist cum Speech Therapist (DEIC): Bachelor Degree in Speech & Language pathology/ B.Sc from a recognized university in India. Physiotherapist (Geriatric): Bachelor Degree in Physiotherapist from a recognized university. Early Intervention cum Health Educator(DEIC): Special Educators Should Possess a Valid Full-time Bachelor degree in Special Education in Intellectual Disability from a recognized university with 5 years of Experience or Master degree in Special Education in Intellectual Disability from a recognized university with 3 years of Experience. Special Educator For Behaviour Therapy (DEIC-OSC): Bachelor degree in Special Education in Intellectual Disability from a recognized university with 5 years of Experience or Master degree in Special Education Intellectual Disability from a recognized university with 3 years of Experience. Optometrist(SNCU): Bachelor degree in Optometry or Master Degree in Optometry from a recognized university in India. Multipurpose Hospital Worker(Pain and Palliative): 8th pass. Multipurpose Hospital Worker(TAEI): 8th pass. CEmONC Security guard: 8th pass. Security (SNCU): 8th pass. Sanitary Worker(SNCU): 8th pass. Quality Manager(TNHSRP): Master Degree in Hospital Administration/ Health Management/Master of Public Health (Regular Course and not Correspondence course).

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for GMCH Sivaganga Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: http://sivaganga.nic.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 11-09-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for GMCH Sivaganga Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: http://sivaganga.nic.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 11-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the GMCH Sivaganga Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the GMCH Sivaganga Various Contractual Posts under NHM is 11 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 11 vacancies announced for various contractual posts under NHM at Government Sivaganga Medical College Hospital Sivaganga.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q4. What are the minimum qualifications required for the posts?
faq.answer: The minimum qualifications vary by post, ranging from 8th pass to Master's degrees in specialized fields like Hospital Administration, Speech & Language Pathology, and Optometry.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary range for the advertised posts?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from ₹11,000/- per month for Multipurpose Hospital Worker and Security posts to ₹60,000/- per month for the Quality Manager post.

faq.question: Q7. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Government Sivaganga Medical College Hospital Sivaganga, which is http://sivaganga.nic.in.

faq.question: Q8. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant educational and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website for GMCH Sivaganga?
faq.answer: The official website for GMCH Sivaganga is http://sivaganga.nic.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for all the advertised posts is contractual.
